 station.

 WDEPC inspection & quality control head sector, MPIS coordinator.

A 
work permit must be issued
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.

Safety fence with 
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes, ear plug and gloves pairs ... 
etc.
